information:
**The Base Registration Fee of RM80 + MYCSA Admin Fee of RM20 is inclusive of all events.**
**All participants will receive complimentary McDonald's lunch, and dessert. After successful registration, we will send the menu to you via email. Please pay attention to your email and place your orders in advance. Please fill out the meal order Google Form by June 8th. Otherwise, we will randomly select a meal for you.**
